open_points.subject: A13 rule 9 edge delivery reporting
open_points.text: “Every edge has exactly one delivery state” and required test 10 says an edge “is reported `undecided`,” but no rule says which run response, inspection, or trace representation reports that state, or whether all edges are included.
open_points.question: Where and when must each edge’s derived delivery state be exposed to callers?
options: Include every edge and its current delivery state in run results and run inspection
Expose delivery states only through trace inspection
Keep delivery states internal and treat “reported” as test terminology rather than a surface result
open_points.default_guess: Include every edge’s derived state in run inspection and in the run result returned after each advancing request.
